name: LILYGO T-Display S3 Pro With OV5640 Camera

touch.notes: Touch may be used for navigation experiments, not final approve/reject signing consent.

display.notes: The larger integrated display is the reason this board is preferred over smaller camera-first boards for local Nostr event review.

camera.pinout_status: confirm against exact board revision before driver work

approval_inputs.name: approve
approval_inputs.notes: Map to an onboard or external physical control after board revision validation; do not accept touch-only approval.

approval_inputs.name: reject
approval_inputs.notes: Map to a different onboard or external physical control after board revision validation.

wireless_policy: Wireless must be disabled or excluded in high-assurance QR vault builds; no Wi-Fi or BLE path may participate in signing approval.
debug_policy: Debug access stays enabled for board bring-up and must be locked before any production-key experiment.
production_signing: disabled until camera, display, physical controls, storage, provisioning, and signing tests pass
